strategy_roster.name: FatlSatlOsma
strategy_roster.notes: The Fatl/Satl oscillator is the built-in MACD signal line, so the documented two-bar rising acceleration with a higher latest value becomes a positive one- and two-bar ROC of MACD(39, 65) using the documented Fast 39 / Slow 65. Docs state there are no stops.

strategy_roster.name: Color RSI MACD
strategy_roster.notes: The default MACD Disposition mode is a crossing between the MACD line and its signal line, using the documented 12/26/9 periods; the opposite cross is the documented exit. Docs state no stop-loss or take-profit levels.

strategy_roster.name: Sensitive MACD Trailing
strategy_roster.notes: The documented 12/26/9 MACD crossover is combined with the MacdOpenLevel magnitude filter, which is given as 3 price points and is therefore normalised to 1% of price. The 35/75 pip stop and target and the pip trailing stop are not percentage fields.

strategy_roster.name: Crypto Scalper Momentum
strategy_roster.entry_long: roc(close, 14) > 0.3 and macd(close, 12, 26) > macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9) and volume_ratio(volume, 20) > 1 and rsi(close, 14) < 70
strategy_roster.notes: MFI is unavailable, so the documented 30/70 MFI thresholds are approximated by RSI(14) and volume_ratio as the volume component, while Momentum and MACD use the documented 14 / 12-26-9 settings. Separate momentum and macro candle feeds, basket targets and money trailing are not expressible.

strategy_roster.name: Heikin Ashi Trader
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > (open + high + low) / 3 and rsi(close, 5) > 80 and ema((high + low + close) / 3, 10) > ema((high + low + close) / 3, 30) and roc(close, 14) > 0.3 and macd(close, 12, 26) > macd_signal(close, 12, 26, 9)
strategy_roster.exit_long: close < (open + high + low) / 3 and ema((high + low + close) / 3, 10) < ema((high + low + close) / 3, 30)
strategy_roster.notes: A bullish Heikin Ashi bar is approximated by close above the bar average, the stochastic overbought read by RSI(5) above 80, and the fast/slow LWMA by EMAs 10/30 of typical price. All periods are explicit fallbacks because the docs list them without values; pip stops, break-even and the kill switch are dropped.

strategy_roster.name: Spreader 2
strategy_roster.notes: This is a two-instrument pair-trading system requiring a configured SecondSecurity and a correlation check, so no single-symbol market signal exists. A never-true guard is used rather than faking the second leg.

strategy_roster.name: VWAP Mean Magnet v9 (Simple Alert)
strategy_roster.entry_long: close < sma((high + low + close) / 3, 60) and rsi(close, 14) < 25
strategy_roster.notes: VWAP is approximated by the 60-bar typical-price average and the documented RSI oversold 25 drives the long; the volume filter of the v2 version is intentionally absent here. The documented Stop loss 0.5% is applied and the exit is the documented VWAP reversion.

strategy_roster.name: Renko Chart
strategy_roster.notes: Docs state the strategy does not place orders and instead rebuilds a Renko symbol stream from tick data. There is no market-derived entry, so a never-true guard is used and the brick-size workflow is not translated.

strategy_roster.name: Earnings Quality Factor
strategy_roster.notes: An annual July 1 cross-sectional rebalance long high-quality and short low-quality stocks needs fundamental scores and multi-name ranking, which a single-symbol DSL cannot express. A never-true guard prevents fabricating a price signal.

strategy_roster.name: IS
strategy_roster.notes: The signal is a switch on an unspecified external source equalling a configurable long/short value, so no market-derived rule can be recovered from the docs. A never-true guard is used; the percentage take-profit and stop-loss also have no documented values.
